briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, we observed multiple cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including seven providers charged for billing $700K in false claims. A Texas woman was added to the FBI's most wanted fraudster list for allegedly committing nearly $100M in healthcare fraud. These cases highlight a significant issue with healthcare fraud nationwide, particularly in Minnesota. Further investigation into the providers and their connections is warranted to uncover the root causes of this issue and potential connections between entities. We will continue to track these cases and look for patterns and connections between entities and programs.
